title: Investor Regret and Stock Returns
authors: Yakup Eser Arısoy; Turan G. Bali; Yi Tang
eligible_reason: Asset-pricing paper: univariate and bivariate portfolio sorts on an investor-regret measure, factor-model alphas (SAS proc model, Newey-West), and Fama-MacBeth cross-sectional regressions (proc reg by month). No treatment adoption or panel DiD; the 'diff-in-diff' in the text is a difference in High-Low REG portfolio alphas across characteristic terciles.
design_notes: Monthly stock-level CRSP/Compustat panel 1963-2020 (dtest.csv), household-level regret from a large brokerage (moms.csv, mwr.csv). Tables 1-8 produced by table*.sas.
data_files_note: Constructed stock-month variables and factor returns shipped as csv.
screener_notes: Published PDF text (data/text/mnsc/mnsc.2022.03389.txt) checked: no DiD/event study design.
